real.defect: runFixtureOracle runs the fixture's own script with node (spawnSync) during feasibility preflight, before any provider request. Code inside a fixture executes on the host.
real.consequence: A third-party or hostile fixture can run arbitrary code with the evaluator user's privileges (reading files outside the fixture, network access). The restricted environment only hides environment variables; it does not confine the filesystem or network.

proof.fix_test_note: The fix's test 'fixture oracle is declarative and cannot execute fixture code' cannot run on the introducing state (no inspectFixtureOracle export); the direct call above is the proof.
